definition: a day off for everyone set by law
description: A sunny city street. A young man in a navy suit, with his blue tie flying and a black briefcase under his arm, pulls hard on the handle of a glass office door and then pushes against the glass with his flat hand, but the building stays locked. Behind him the street is closed to traffic and full of people with the day off: a woman in a yellow top and red skirt dances, a man jumps to catch a frisbee, a cyclist rides past and friends sit on blankets under colourful bunting.

taps.phrase: to tug at a locked door
to twirl in a red skirt
